packageRules.description: Trusted vendors (large orgs / foundations with strong release discipline). Shorten the 90-day cool-down to 14 days: enough time for the upstream to yank or patch a bad release (e.g. aws-sdk-go v1.55.6), but no longer than that. CVEs still flow through the vulnerabilityAlerts channel without any delay.
Trusted Go-module paths that don't live on github.com. Same 14-day cool-down rationale as the trusted-vendors rule above.

Pin github.com/prometheus/prometheus to the v2.x line (Go module versions < v0.300.0). v3.x releases are published as v0.300.0+ and require major migration work, so we stay on the latest v2.x until migration is planned.

Stay on aws-sdk-go v1.55.5: newer v1.55.x revisions added package-level // Deprecated: annotations that staticcheck (SA1019) reports as fatal across upstream discovery/aws/*. Bump only after migrating to aws-sdk-go-v2 (see #330).

Keep googletest below 1.18.0. googletest >= 1.18.0 depends on abseil-cpp >= 20260526.0, the first abseil release without compatibility_level (level 0), while protobuf <= 37 (transitive via rules_cc and aspect_rules_lint) declares abseil compatibility level 1, so bzlmod cannot resolve the pp module graph; protobuf >= 30 also needs Bazel 8. Remove this limit after the migration to Bazel 8 and to a protobuf that accepts abseil >= 20260526.

Keep abseil-cpp below 20260526.0, the first release without compatibility_level (level 0). protobuf <= 37 (transitive via rules_cc and aspect_rules_lint) declares abseil compatibility level 1 and protobuf >= 30 needs Bazel 8. Remove this limit after the migration to Bazel 8 and to a protobuf that accepts abseil >= 20260526. Matches the http_archive in pp/third_party/deps.bzl and a future bazel_dep module abseil-cpp.
